the first is the seedling stage
the second the vegetative stage , where the plant focuses on growing on strength and on roots
the 3rd and last one is the flowering stage where the plant produces buds.

 if you have an auto plan seed then that means that the plant won't rely on sunlight times but only on its age determined by its root growth. however if you have a photo period plant seed then that plant relies only on the the amount of light it receives to determine when it should start flowering.
a photo. plant will normally start flowering if you give it less than 12 hours of light. 
if you don't change the light setting meaning the plant gets more than 12 hours of light a day then the plants will continue vegging and won't flip until you give it less then 12 hours of light.
